# Facebook (22 endpoints)

## Endpoints

| Resource | Params | Credits | Description |
|----------|--------|---------|-------------|
| /profile | `url` | 1 | Get Facebook page profile |
| /profile/posts | `url` / `pageId` | 1 | List Facebook page posts |
| /post | `url` | 1 | Get Facebook post details |
| /post/comments | `url` / `feedback_id` | 1 | List Facebook post comments |
| /group/posts | `url` / `group_id` | 1 | List Facebook group posts |
| /post/transcript | `url` | 10 | Get Facebook video transcript — ⛔ **BANNED in this plugin: 10 credits, no advantage. Transcribe with the local captions→Groq→Whisper chain instead.** |
| /profile/photos | `url` | 1 | List Facebook profile photos |
| /profile/reels | `url` | 1 | List Facebook profile reels |
| /adlibrary/ad | `id` / `url` | 5 | Get Facebook Ad Library ad details |
| /adlibrary/company/ads | `pageId` / `companyName` | 5 | List Facebook Ad Library company ads |
| /adlibrary/search/ads | `query` | 5 | Search Facebook Ad Library |
| /adlibrary/search/companies | `query` | 5 | Search Facebook Ad Library companies |
| /profile/events | `url` | 1 | List a Facebook page's events |
| /post/comment/replies | `feedback_id`, `expansion_token` | 1 | List replies to a Facebook post comment |
| /marketplace/location/search | `query` | 1 | Search Facebook Marketplace locations |
| /marketplace/search | `query`, `lat`, `lng` | 1 | Search Facebook Marketplace listings |
| /marketplace/item | `id` / `url` | 1 | Get a Facebook Marketplace item |
| /events/search | `query` | 1 | Search Facebook events by keyword |
| /events | `url` | 1 | List Facebook events for a city |
| /event/details | `id` / `url` | 1 | Get details for a Facebook event |
| /adlibrary/ad/transcript | `id` / `url` | 10 | Get a Facebook Ad Library video ad transcript — ⛔ **BANNED in this plugin: 10 credits, no advantage. Transcribe with the local captions→Groq→Whisper chain instead.** |
| /profile/full | *(none)* | **5** | Facebook profile, recent posts, and computed analytics in one call. |

### Parameter legend

- `a`, `b` — both required.
- `a` / `b` — a `oneOf` group: at least one member must be provided.
- *(none)* — no required parameters.

## Parameter Details

- `url`: Full URL of the Facebook page or profile
- `get_business_hours` *(optional, string)*: Get the business's hours
- `url (/profile/posts)` *(optional, string)*: Full URL of the Facebook page or profile to fetch posts for
- `pageId` *(optional, string)*: Facebook profile page id
- `cursor` *(optional, string)*: To paginate through the posts
- `url (/post)`: Full URL of the Facebook post
- `get_comments` *(optional, boolean)*: Whether you want to get the first several comments of the post
- `get_transcript` *(optional, boolean)*: Whether you want to get the transcript of the post
- `url (/post/comments)` *(optional, string)*: Full URL of the Facebook post to fetch comments for
- `feedback_id` *(optional, string)*: Using feedback_id (instead of url) will *really* speed up the request. You can get the feedback_id when you make a request to /v1/facebook/post.
- `cursor (/post/comments)` *(optional, string)*: Cursor to get more comments. Get 'cursor' from previous response.
- `url (/group/posts)` *(optional, string)*: Full URL of the Facebook group
- `group_id` *(optional, string)*: The ID of the group
- `sort_by` *(optional, enum: TOP_POSTS | RECENT_ACTIVITY | CHRONOLOGICAL | CHRONOLOGICAL_LISTINGS)*: How to sort the posts
- `url (/post/transcript)`: Full URL of the Facebook video post
- `next_page_id` *(optional, string)*: To paginate through to the next page
- `cursor (/profile/photos)` *(optional, string)*: To paginate through to the next page
- `cursor (/profile/reels)` *(optional, string)*: To paginate through to the next page
- `id` *(optional, string)*: Facebook Ad Library ad ID
- `url (/adlibrary/ad)` *(optional, string)*: Facebook Ad URL
- `trim` *(optional, boolean)*: Set to true for a trimmed down version of the response
- `pageId (/adlibrary/company/ads)` *(optional, string)*: Facebook page ID of the advertiser
- `companyName` *(optional, string)*: The name of the company. Can either use this or pageId
- `country` *(optional, string)*: This can only be one country. It has to be the 2 letter code for the country. It defaults to ALL.
- `status` *(optional, enum: ALL | ACTIVE | INACTIVE)*: Status of the ad. Defaults to ACTIVE.
- `media_type` *(optional, enum: ALL | IMAGE | VIDEO | MEME | IMAGE_AND_MEME | NONE)*: Media type of the ad. Defaults to ALL. Meme refers to ads with image and text. Not sure why they call it meme.
- `language` *(optional, string)*: Language to filter ads on. Needs to be 2 letter language code, ie EN, ES, FR, etc
- `sort_by (/adlibrary/company/ads)` *(optional, enum: total_impressions | relevancy_monthly_grouped)*: Sort by impressions (high to low), or Most Recent (relevancy_monthly_grouped). Defaults to impressions.
- `start_date` *(optional, string)*: Start date to search for. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
- `end_date` *(optional, string)*: End date to search for. Format: YYYY-MM-DD
- `cursor (/adlibrary/company/ads)` *(optional, string)*: Cursor to paginate through results
- `query`: Search keyword or phrase to find ads in the Facebook Ad Library
- `sort_by (/adlibrary/search/ads)` *(optional, enum: total_impressions | relevancy_monthly_grouped)*: Sort by impressions (high to low), or Most Recent (relevancy_monthly_grouped). Defaults to impressions.
- `search_type` *(optional, enum: keyword_unordered | keyword_exact_phrase)*: If you want to search by exact phrase or not
- `ad_type` *(optional, enum: all | political_and_issue_ads)*: Search for all ads or only political and issue ads
- `media_type (/adlibrary/search/ads)` *(optional, enum: ALL | IMAGE | VIDEO | MEME | IMAGE_AND_MEME | NONE)*: Media type of the ad. Defaults to ALL. Meme just means the ad has text and an image. No clue why they call it meme.
- `start_date (/adlibrary/search/ads)` *(optional, string)*: Impressions start date. Needs to be in YYYY-MM-DD format.
- `end_date (/adlibrary/search/ads)` *(optional, string)*: Impressions end date. Needs to be in YYYY-MM-DD format.
- `cursor (/adlibrary/search/ads)` *(optional, string)*: Cursor to paginate through results
- `query (/adlibrary/search/companies)`: Search keyword or phrase to find companies in the Facebook Ad Library
- `url (/profile/events)`: Full URL of the public Facebook page.
- `cursor (/profile/events)` *(optional, string)*: Cursor returned by the previous response for pagination.
- `feedback_id (/post/comment/replies)`: `feedback_id` from `/v1/facebook/post/comments` for the parent comment (this is NOT the comment ID).
- `expansion_token`: `expansion_token` from `/v1/facebook/post/comments` for the parent comment.
- `cursor (/post/comment/replies)` *(optional, string)*: Cursor returned by the previous response for pagination.
- `query (/marketplace/location/search)`: Location search query (city or area name).
- `query (/marketplace/search)`: Search keyword (e.g., `bike`, `couch`).
- `lat`: Latitude of the search location.
- `lng`: Longitude of the search location.
- `radius_km` *(optional, integer)*: Search radius in kilometers.
- `min_price` *(optional, integer)*: Minimum listing price.
- `max_price` *(optional, integer)*: Maximum listing price.
- `count` *(optional, integer)*: Number of listings to return per page.
- `sort_by (/marketplace/search)` *(optional, enum: suggested | distance_ascend | creation_time_descend | price_ascend | price_descend)*: Sort order for results.
- `delivery_method` *(optional, enum: all | local_pickup | shipping)*: Delivery filter — local pickup only, shipping only, or all.
- `condition` *(optional, enum: new | used_like_new | used_good | used_fair)*: Filter listings by item condition.
- `date_listed` *(optional, enum: all | 1 | 7 | 30 | last_24_hours | last_7_days | last_30_days)*: Filter by listing recency (relative window or numeric day count).
- `availability` *(optional, enum: available | sold | all)*: Filter by listing status — `available`, `sold`, or `all`.
- `cursor (/marketplace/search)` *(optional, string)*: Opaque pagination cursor returned by the previous response — forward as-is.
- `id (/marketplace/item)` *(optional, string)*: Facebook Marketplace item ID (numeric).
- `url (/marketplace/item)` *(optional, string)*: Full URL of the Marketplace item.
- `query (/events/search)`: Event name or keyword to search for.
- `cursor (/events/search)` *(optional, string)*: Cursor returned by the previous response for pagination.
- `url (/events)`: Full URL of the city's Facebook Events page.
- `time` *(optional, enum: today | this_week | next_week)*: Relative time window. Defaults to all time when omitted.
- `cursor (/events)` *(optional, string)*: Cursor returned by the previous response for pagination.
- `id (/event/details)` *(optional, string)*: Facebook event ID (numeric).
- `url (/event/details)` *(optional, string)*: Full URL of the event.
- `id (/adlibrary/ad/transcript)` *(optional, string)*: Facebook Ad Library ad ID.
- `url (/adlibrary/ad/transcript)` *(optional, string)*: Facebook Ad Library ad URL.
- `posts` *(optional, integer)*: How many recent posts to fetch + average the computed metrics over (1–100, default 25).
- `cursor (/profile/full)` *(optional, string)*: Pass a prior response's posts_cursor to deepen the post window.
- `include` *(optional, string)*: CSV subset of posts,computed (default both). include=computed drops the raw posts[] to save payload.

## Field Maps


The `profile` endpoint returns an `Author` response normalized by the `facebook-author` field map, and `post` returns a `Post` normalized by `facebook-post`. Both include computed fields under `data.computed`. Use `?format=raw` to bypass both. Other Facebook endpoints are passthrough.

## Example

```bash
curl "https://www.socialcrawl.dev/v1/facebook/profile?url=https://www.facebook.com/Meta" \
  -H "x-api-key: $SOCIALCRAWL_API_KEY"
```
